verses.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder

verses.t: And when the stars fall, scattering
And when the seas are erupted
verses.pickthall: When the seas are poured forth

verses.t: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back
verses.pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind

verses.t: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous
verses.pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful

verses.t: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you
verses.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee

verses.t: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you
verses.pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee

verses.t: No! But you deny the Recompense
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment

verses.t: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers
verses.pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians

verses.t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight

verses.t: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire
verses.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell

verses.t: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment

verses.t: And never therefrom will they be absent
verses.pickthall: And will not be absent thence

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

verses.t: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

verses.t: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah
verses.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's
